title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription options follow meeting policies
summary: The briefing accurately reports the policy-aligned choices, automatic rollout and tenant notice's schedule. The documented controls and licensing caveats are supported; the governance checklist should also have a table row for policy assignments.

claims.claim: Organisers see only automatic recording and transcription choices allowed by their assigned meeting policies.
claims.quote: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The new Record only choice automatically starts recording without starting transcription.
claims.quote: A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription.

claims.quote: AllowedAllowedRecord and transcribe; Transcribe only; Record only; Off

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe the aligned choices, and the auto recording page does not mention Record only or Transcribe only.

claims.quote: This setting doesn't apply to transcripts.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A recording made with transcription turned off has no transcript file stored next to it.
claims.quote: If recording is turned on, but transcription is turned off, the recording doesn't have a transcript file stored next to it.

claims.claim: Captions cannot be turned on in Stream playback when the recording was made with transcription turned off.
claims.quote: If recording is turned on, but transcription is turned off, the recording doesn't have a transcript file stored next to it. Also, when viewing the recording playback in Stream, captions can't be turned on.

claims.claim: Private meeting recordings are uploaded to the organiser's OneDrive.
claims.quote: It gets uploaded to the meeting organizer's OneDrive (private meetings) or SharePoint (channel meetings).

claims.claim: Channel meeting recordings are stored in the channel's SharePoint site.
claims.quote: Channel meeting recordings and transcripts are saved to a Recordings folder in the channel's SharePoint site.

claims.claim: The sources specify no new recording storage location for this change.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams automatic recording transcription choices admin policies tenant disable rollout switch Record only. Read the roadmap, MC1508234 and meeting-recording, including Permissions and storage; no change-specific storage location is stated.

claims.claim: The separate ExplicitRecordingConsent meeting policy parameter requires recording or transcription consent in meetings created by organisers assigned the policy.
claims.quote:
To require participants to give their explicit consent to be recorded or transcribed in any meeting that organizers with this policy create, run the following command:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ExplicitRecordingConsent Enabled

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified how explicit recording consent interacts with the new automatic choices.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams automatic recording new options ExplicitRecordingConsent sensitivity labels meeting templates AutoRecording AllowCloudRecording AllowTranscription. Read meeting-recording and the participant agreement search excerpt; neither addresses the new menu.

claims.claim: Selecting an automatic option allows capture to start without an in-meeting button press.
claims.quote: If they choose to use this template, recording and transcription starts automatically without any user interaction.

claims.claim: For meetings, enabling the auto recording policy leaves the organiser's meeting option Off by default.
claims.quote: When you turn on the auto recording policy for an organizer, the meeting option for Record and transcribe automatically is Off by default.

claims.claim: Organisers must enable the automatic setting separately for each meeting they want automatically captured.
claims.quote: Organizers must manually enable Record and transcribe automatically setting for each meeting they want recorded and transcribed automatically.

claims.claim: The existing automatic setting is On by default for webinars and town halls.
claims.quote: For webinars and town halls, the setting is On by default.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy supports Identity and AutoRecording with Enabled or Disabled to control whether organisers have the automatic setting.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Enabled
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AutoRecording Disabled

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Meeting recording is configured in Teams admin center under Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select an existing policy or create a new one.
Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy with Identity and AllowCloudRecording true or false controls whether users can record meetings.
claims.quote:
To manage meeting recording by using PowerShell, use the -AllowCloudRecording parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Transcription is configured in Teams admin center under Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy with Identity and AllowTranscription true or false manages meeting transcription.
claims.quote:
To manage meeting transcription using PowerShell, use the -AllowTranscription parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: No separate tenant-wide UI or API switch for the new menu or Record only is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams automatic recording transcription choices admin policies tenant disable rollout switch Record only. Read auto recording, recording policies, sensitive-meeting options and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy for AutoRecording; no separate rollout or Record-only switch is documented.

claims.claim: Learn distinguishes the absence of an admin policy enforcing Record and transcribe automatically from the PowerShell policy controlling its visibility.
claims.quote: There isn't an admin policy for Record and transcribe automatically. However, to control whether organizers have the Record and transcribe automatically setting in their Meeting options, you can use the Auto recording policy in PowerShell.

claims.claim: The existing auto recording policy applies to users and groups.
claims.quote: You can only apply this policy setting to users and groups.

claims.claim: The existing AutoRecording Disabled setting hides Record and transcribe automatically from organisers.
claims.quote: If you turn off auto recording, organizers don't see Record and transcribe automatically in meeting options and can't set meetings to record automatically.

claims.claim: Meeting policies can be assigned to specific users in Teams admin center.
claims.quote: To specific users: Select your policy, select Manage users > Assign users, enter the names of specific users in the search bar, select Add, and then select Apply.

claims.claim: Meeting policies can be assigned to groups in Teams admin center.
claims.quote: To groups: Go to the Group policy assignment tab, select Add, enter the group name, select the policy name, and then select Apply.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks readers to review has a row in the controls table.
claims.quote: Review policy assignments to users and groups so the effective policy for each organiser group is the one you intend. The table covers auto recording visibility, recording permission, transcription permission and a separate tenant switch, but has no policy-assignment row.
claims.fix: Add a row for assignment of meeting policies to users and groups. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-recording and give Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Manage users > Assign users; describe the Group policy assignment route in its note.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends informing meeting organisers about the new Record only option.
claims.quote:
We recommend that:

- Inform meeting organizers about the new Record only option.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends communicating that assigned meeting policies determine the available automatic choices.
claims.quote: Communicate that available automatic recording and transcription options are now determined by the organizer's assigned Teams meeting policies.

claims.quote: Searched: Teams automatic recording new options ExplicitRecordingConsent sensitivity labels meeting templates AutoRecording AllowCloudRecording AllowTranscription. Read MC1508234, manage-teams-auto-recording and the AutoRecording cmdlet reference; none explains the interaction.
